# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/trjcat

## Summary

Wrapper class for the GROMACS trjcat module.

The GROMACS solvate module generates a box around the selected structure.

Nextflow adapter of the [Trjcat](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.trjcat) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_TRJCAT } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/trjcat'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_TRJCAT(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_trj_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the input GROMACS trajectories (xtc, trr, cpt, gro, pdb, tng) to concatenate in zip format |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_trj_path` | yes | pdb, gro, xtc, trr, tng | Path to the output trajectory file |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Trjcat properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_trj_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_TRJCAT' {
        ext.properties = [concatenate: true]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `concatenate` | boolean | true | Only concatenate the files without removal of frames with identical timestamps. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
